name: Ground Station
what_it_is: An open-source satellite tracking and radio communication suite with a React/FastAPI web UI. It supports real-time and automated pass monitoring, SDR IQ acquisition, spectrum analysis, demodulation, and satellite telemetry decoding for amateur radio operators and researchers.
components: React SPA frontend (Redux Toolkit, Material-UI, Socket.IO)
FastAPI backend (REST + WebSocket APIs, worker process manager)
Satellite tracker worker (orbital calculations, pass predictions, antenna/radio control)
Local and remote SDR discovery probes
SatDump integration (pinned to commit 7aef0fe) for METEOR image processing
protocols: SDR (Software-Defined Radio) IQ acquisition via SoapySDR ecosystem
SoapySDR (RTL-SDR, Airspy, AirspyHF, HackRF, PlutoSDR, LimeSDR, SDRplay, USRP, HydraSDR, bladeRF)
measurement: Real-time orbital parameter calculation and satellite pass prediction
Per-subscriber queue health metrics and data-flow statistics
Live speech-to-text transcription (Gemini Live or Deepgram)
IQ signal recording with full orbital metadata (SigMF)
configuration: GR_BUFFER_TYPE env var (e.g. vmcirc_mmap_tmpfile for GNU Radio buffer tuning)
UHD_IMAGES_DIR and UHD_CONFIG_DIR for USRP firmware paths
Configurable pass-elevation thresholds and lookahead windows for automated observations
TLE auto-sync from CelesTrak and SatNOGS databases
Multi-SDR simultaneous sessions with independent configuration per receiver
modes: Real-time manual satellite tracking and observation
Automated scheduled observations triggered by satellite pass predictions
IQ playback through virtual SDR device
Normal-mode demodulation (user playback) running simultaneously with internal-mode demodulation (decoder pipeline)
constraints: AFSK packet and LoRa/GMSK decoders are marked WIP and currently non-functional
NOAA APT weather satellite decoding is not yet implemented
METEOR satellite image processing requires the bundled SatDump installation (external dependency, pinned commit)
Container must run with --network host and --privileged to support USB SDR device access and mDNS discovery
Volume mount required at /app/backend/data for database, recordings, snapshots, and UHD images to persist
Single exposed port (7000); no docker-compose file present — deployment is single-container only
docker_services: ground-station (single container, port 7000, host networking, USB device passthrough via /dev/bus/usb, volume /app/backend/data)
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — only a single Dockerfile; multi-service orchestration must be handled externally
No dedicated database container — SQLite used internally within the single container
No message broker service (ZeroMQ is used in-process, not as a separate container)
AFSK, LoRa, and GMSK decoders absent from functional feature set (marked WIP)
